items.title: BE Investors Have Opportunity to Lead Bloom Energy Corporation Securities Fraud Lawsuit with SBS Law
items.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against Bloom Energy Corporation for alleged securities violations. The company is accused of making false and misleading statements regarding its sourcing of scandium, which was actually sourced from China through middlemen while the company understated its reliance on Chinese scandium. The class period runs from February 27, 2025 to July 8, 2026, with a deadline of September 28, 2026 for investors to participate.
